items.title: Eddie Palmieri — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He had a Cuban young lady called Marta, who he danced with.

ctx.x: Yes. Then his wife would sing like “Poor Butterfly.” She dressed like in a kimono. He had a Cuban young lady called Marta, who he danced with. I had my cuz... I call him “Cuz,” but it was Luis Goicochea playing conga—we were very good buddies. Julio Andino, the great Julio Andino, who had a band that played...he was Tito’s bass player for a while. A gentleman called Morty Lazar on sax. We had a trumpet player, Joe Demerre(?—54:08), who did a takeoff on Louis Prima, but the money he charged...that he wanted Tito…
